Name: Fan the Flame
Components: S, M (a torn off moth wing)
Description: You mystically extend the wing in your hand to become a blazing fan and then beat it, causing a great scorching gale to overtake the area within range. All creatures of your choice must pass a Constitution saving throw or suffer 1 Burn count and then have all failing creature's count of the Condition be summed up and then divided equally amongst them.
